item_name: Rothco Gadsden Don't Tread On Me Bandana
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Gadsden Don’t Tread On Me Bandana is a versatile accessory featuring the iconic Gadsden snake graphic in all 4 corners. Crafted from durable and breathable cotton, this bandana offers both comfort and functionality. Measuring 22 inch x 22 inch, it can be used in various ways, including as a headband, facemask, neck gaiter, or dust mask. Perfect for outdoor enthusiasts, it also doubles as a practical tool, such as a pouch, tourniquet, or lightweight cover.
